categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in construction, building materials, and retail/wholesale sectors. Its construction segment focuses on residential and commercial building development, including urban renewal and joint development projects. The building materials segment supplies eco-friendly and innovative materials, while the retail segment manages shopping malls and sells diverse consumer goods.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs innovative construction methods such as precast concrete, spiral stirrups, thermal insulation mortars, and soundproof flooring to enhance quality and efficiency. It integrates smart production and information management systems and emphasizes green building technologies to reduce carbon footprint and improve energy efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include homebuyers, commercial tenants, and retail consumers primarily in the Taipei metropolitan area. The company targets first-time and replacement homebuyers, commercial real estate users, and general consumers for its retail operations. It also serves government and public sector clients through BOT and joint development projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, especially in the Greater Taipei area and New Taipei City, focusing on prime urban locations and emerging redevelopment zones. The company also engages in land development and construction projects in other Taiwanese regions with growth potential.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain, including land development, building construction, and property management. It sources raw materials like land and building supplies from upstream suppliers and delivers finished residential, commercial properties, and retail services to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainable development with a focus on ESG compliance, carbon footprint reduction, and green building certifications. R&D efforts target innovative construction techniques, energy-saving materials, and smart building technologies to enhance product differentiation and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through property sales, rental income from commercial real estate, building materials sales, and retail operations. The company also earns investment income from equity-method subsidiaries and joint ventures, as well as service fees from property management and BOT projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a strong market position in Taiwan's construction and real estate sectors, leveraging its brand, financial strength, and integrated development capabilities. It competes with other major Taiwanese developers and construction firms, differentiating itself through innovative building methods and diversified business segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the latest fiscal year, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$31.8 billion and net income attributable to owners of NT$16.56 billion, showing significant growth over the prior year. Total assets reached about NT$194 billion with steady expansion in investment properties and equity holdings, reflecting a robust growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, environmentally friendly, and energy-efficient living spaces, supported by patented construction technologies and comprehensive after-sales services. Its integrated approach combining land development, innovative construction, and retail operations creates unique value and stable profitability for customers and investors.
